sections.label: Safeguards for minors' aesthetic procedures
sections.summary: MOH does not track private hospital cosmetic surgeries, while SMC guidelines require parental consent, a cooling-off period, and no aesthetic procedures for minors unless in their best interest.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The Ministry of Health (MOH) does not track cosmetic surgeries done in the private hospitals.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The Singapore Medical Council's (SMC's) Ethical Code and Ethical Guidelines stipulate that minors, defined as those under the age of 21, have to obtain their parents' or legal guardians' written consent prior to undergoing invasive procedures.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: For aesthetic procedures in particular, SMC's ethical guidelines stipulate that doctors must give patients a "cooling off" period to reconsider their decision before proceeding with the treatment.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Also, they must not offer aesthetic procedures to minors, unless independent professional assessments indicate that these procedures are truly in their best interest.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: MOH's assessment is that these safeguards are appropriate.

sections.label: Considering data collection and consultation
sections.summary: The suggestion to collect data on minors undergoing aesthetic or cosmetic surgery in private hospitals will be looked at, and the Academy of Medicine will be consulted on guideline feasibility.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: As to the first one, whether we will consider collecting a data of minors undergoing aesthetic or cosmetic surgery in private hospitals, we will look at this suggestion.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: As for the guidelines for cosmetic or aesthetic surgery for minors, we will consult the Academy of Medicine whether this would be feasible.
